subject: maths
summary: Maths shows most questions and schemes as crops of the official paper rather than as text. On desktop these crops read well, but on a 390px phone the crop is shrunk to fit and the print inside it is roughly half the size of the app's own text, so the question itself and the worked solution are close to unreadable without tapping Enlarge. Five of the twelve sampled cards show no scheme at all after the reveal: only a button to open 3-4 printed pages and a list of credit levels, so the student cannot see the answer on the card. The attached page reader opens at the top of the whole printed page, which in several cards is a different question or an empty working grid rather than the part being asked. The two cards that render the question as real text (9, 12) are the cleanest to read but have no inline scheme, and card 9 says 'shown below' with no diagram on the card.

issues.title: Question is an image crop with tiny print on the phone
issues.detail: On 10 of 12 cards the question is only a crop of the printed paper. On the phone it is scaled to the card width, so the question wording is about 5-7px high against 15px app body text (cards 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11). The student must tap Enlarge just to read what is being asked. The typed stem and question text exist in the data but are not shown.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the typed question text at app body size (as cards 9 and 12 do) and keep the crop only for the diagram; or render the crop at a width that keeps print at least 13px and let it scroll sideways.

issues.title: No marking scheme visible after reveal
issues.detail: After 'Reveal the marking scheme' the card shows only 'Select the credit your working earns', a button 'Open worked solution - 3/4 printed pages', and a list of credit levels (0/4/7/9/10). There is no answer, no working and no description of what earns low or high partial credit. The reveal reveals nothing; the student has to open and hunt through several printed pages.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the cropped worked solution and the partial-credit notes for this part inline, as cards 3, 5, 8 and 10 do. At minimum show the final answer and what each credit level requires.

issues.title: Attached page opens on a different question or part
issues.detail: The page reader opens at the top of the full printed page, not at the part asked. Card 5 (Q4(a)) opens on Q3(c) 'show that ABCD is a parallelogram' and a full empty grid. Card 7 (Q6(a)) opens on the whole of Q5 (a), (b), (c) with its helicopter diagram; Q6 is below the fold. Card 10 (Q9(e)) opens on Q9(d) and its empty grid. Card 2 opens on the blank working grid left from Q6A. Cards 3, 6, 8, 9, 12 open on earlier sibling parts.
issues.suggested_fix: Crop the attached page to this question's region, or scroll the reader to the part asked. The inline crop already does this correctly; the reader should match it or be dropped where the crop is complete.

issues.title: Worked-solution image unreadable on phone
issues.detail: Where a scheme crop is shown inline, on the phone its text is about 4-6px high. Card 2's four alternative proofs and card 6's calculus working cannot be read at all without Enlarge; card 5's one-line answer sits in a tiny box.
issues.suggested_fix: Type the final answer and the credit notes as text beneath the image, and show the working crop at a readable zoom with horizontal pan, or split it into answer box and notes.

issues.title: Scheme crop repeats the question
issues.detail: The scheme image on cards 3, 8 and 10 starts by reprinting the whole question before the answer box, which pushes the answer down and wastes phone height.
issues.suggested_fix: Crop the scheme image from the answer box downwards.

issues.title: Inconsistent crop scale between cards
issues.detail: Crops are scaled to fill the column regardless of how wide the source region is, so card 5's question prints at roughly twice the size of the app text on desktop while cards 4, 7 and 11 print smaller than the app text. Cards look like they come from different apps.
issues.suggested_fix: Render every crop at a fixed scale relative to the source page so print size is the same across cards.

issues.title: Text card refers to a diagram that is not shown
issues.detail: Card 9 reads well as text but says 'The design, shown below' and 'as shown in the diagram below' with no diagram on the card; it is only in the attached pages.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the table diagram crop under the stem.

issues.title: Card 2: diagram letter and scheme correction note
issues.detail: The stem says the incircle has centre O but the printed diagram reads as 'Q' at the centre (and Q again at the foot). The scheme opens with an app note correcting the official scheme ('the two occurrences of angle PBR should read angle PCR'), which is useful but refers to 'scheme PDF page 56', which means nothing to a student.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a one-line caption that the centre is O, and reword the correction note to point at the first boxed proof rather than a PDF page number.

issues.title: Empty band and duplicate controls
issues.detail: On the phone there is an empty white band of roughly 200-250px between the question-pages button and 'Your answer' on every card. On cards with an inline scheme there are both an 'Enlarge worked solution' button and an 'Open worked solution' panel, and on the question side 'Enlarge', 'Open original paper' and 'Open question pages' all sit together.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the minimum height on the question block on phones and merge the overlapping open/enlarge controls.

good_examples.why: Question crop is large and legible with its diagram, and the scheme shows the answer and credit notes inline
Full official working and credit notes for exactly this part, clear on desktop
Question typed as real text, perfectly readable on the phone (though the scheme is missing)
